source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:2 (the ciphers; the three); Minchat Shai on 20:2 (the triple-plene roster)
claim_en: ANOKHI YHWH elohekha asher HOTZETIKHA ('I am the LORD your God, who BROUGHT YOU OUT of the land of Egypt'): the brought-you-out word stands exactly THREE times in the Torah (census checked): UR OF THE CHALDEES ('I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur,' Gen 15:7 — to ABRAHAM) and the TWO DECALOGUES (here and Deut 5:6) — the Kitzur: 'who brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees TO GIVE HIS SONS THE TORAH' (the covenant of the pieces and the two Sinais on one word: the nation's exodus spelled with the father's); MS with the Ramah: all three written FULL-FULL-FULL (vav before the tzadi, alef before the tav, yod before the kaf — the triple-plene roster; and the Jerusalem Talmud's lean tradition named: 'the Gemara sometimes disputes our books' — the split filed); and ANOKHI = KISE ('throne,' 81 = 81, asserted at the build) — the Kitzur: 'He tore all the firmaments down to the THRONE OF GLORY' to say I: the first word of the Ten weighing exactly the seat it descended from.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:13 (the crown-count; the eqev-count; alef-to-kaf; the sixth)
claim_en: The Decalogue's own arithmetic, all machine-verified on the SNAPSHOT at the build: the Ten (20:2-17) hold exactly 620 LETTERS = KETER ('crown,' 620) — the Kitzur: 'the 613 commandments and the seven of the sons of Noah — and their sign is THE CROWN OF TORAH: learned for its own sake, a crown for his head'; exactly 172 WORDS = EQEV (172) — 'EQEV asher shama Avraham be-qoli' ('BECAUSE Abraham heard My voice' — the Ten counted in the word of Abraham's obedience; Eliezer's half-shekel and two bracelets named: the two tablets and the ten utterances); the Ten OPEN with alef (anokhi) and CLOSE with kaf (le-reekha) — AKH: 'SURELY good to Israel' (the whole code bracketed by one adverb of pure good); and LO TIRTZACH — the SIXTH utterance — holds exactly SIX LETTERS (checked): 'for MAN WAS CREATED ON THE SIXTH DAY' (the murder-ban sized to the birthday of its victim); lo-tignov counted to the KIDNAPPER (the tradition's near-count named as its own device).

source: Minchat Shai on the Decalogue (the Chizkuni; the Zohar); the two-word verse census
claim_en: lo tirtzach / lo tinaf / lo tignov ('no murder / no adultery / no theft'): the Chizkuni's census claim — 'in ALL of Scripture there is no verse of two words EXCEPT THESE' — and the Torah-side count is EXACT (asserted at the build): the whole Torah holds exactly SIX two-word verses — murder, adultery, theft, in BOTH Decalogues (Exod 20:13-15, Deut 5:17-19): the three shortest laws in the language, each two words, each twice; the Zohar's doctrine on their accents carried (MS): 'the PAUSING ACCENT in these three — were it not for the pause, murder would be forbidden even for the court, union forbidden even in marriage, theft forbidden even of a teacher's attention: the pause FORBIDS AND PERMITS' (the cantillation as the law's own hinge); and the two-reading system named: on Shavuot the upper accents bind each utterance into one verse; in the year's course the lower accents cut them into these smallest verses in Scripture.

source: Minchat Shai on the Decalogue's double pointing (ibn Habib; the Rama of Fano; the Jerusalem Talmud)
claim_en: al-PANAI ('before My face,' closing the no-other-gods verse): the token carries TWO VOWELS on one reading-slot — the qamatz of the verse-end reading AND the patach of the running reading (the patach checked in-token; both codepoints asserted at the build; מתחת at 20:4's mid-verse rest likewise double-pointed, asserted) — MS's essay from ibn Habib and the Jerusalem Talmud: 'there are TWO READINGS of the utterances: the LONE reader divides by his own verse-order — the public reader reads EACH UTTERANCE WHOLE: from this follows the change in accents, in vowels, and in soft-and-hard letters, to keep both readings' (pani in qamatz for the verse-closer, patach for the runner-on); the FOUR letters both hard and soft named (the kaf of kol-melakhtekha, the three tavs of the short prohibitions); and the Rama of Fano's warning carried: 'he who reads BOTH vowels aloud — it is a great error, and they silence him with rebuke' (the doubled text is a fork, not a chord); the corpus files what its stream holds: the SNAPSHOT preserves the double vowels at pani and mitachat, and prints the pausal alone at tirtzach — the stream's own shape recorded.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:6 (the kindness-file; the seven crownlets)
claim_en: VE-OSE CHESED la-alafim ('and DOING KINDNESS to thousands, to those who love Me'): the doing-kindness contact stands THREE times in the Torah (adjacency checked): the SERVANT'S PRAYER ('and DO KINDNESS with my master Abraham,' Gen 24:12 — the corpus's first do-kindness is a plea FOR a master) and the TWO DECALOGUES (here and Deut 5:10 — the Master's own pledge to thousands); the Kitzur's Scripture-file: the four with the lamed, two in the utterances and two of DAVID ('who does kindness is done kindness — David dealt kindness even with the nations, therefore kindness was dealt him'); and the next utterance's ornament filed as the tradition's instrument-gap: SEVEN CROWNLETS on the shin of lo-tisa (the tagin — not carried in the SNAPSHOT's letter-stream, named): seven against the seven-times-lie of Ezekiel, the seven abominations, the seven names of the evil impulse, the seven rungs of Gehinnom — the oath-ban wearing its sevens above the line.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:8 (the zakhor arithmetic)
claim_en: ZAKHOR et-yom ha-shabat le-qadsho ('REMEMBER the sabbath day, to keep it holy'): the Kitzur's arithmetic, machine-verified at the build: the verse holds exactly FIVE WORDS (checked) — 'whoever upholds the Sabbath is as one who upholds the FIVE BOOKS of the Torah'; it is the SEVENTH VERSE of the Decalogue's span (counting from anokhi — verified) and OPENS WITH ZAYIN (= seven): 'because the Sabbath is the seventh'; and SEVEN RESTERS are listed in its law (20:10, counted at the build): you, your son, your daughter, your servant, your maid, your beast, and your stranger — 'and against them the seven rests were ordained': the seventh-day command arriving as verse seven, letter seven, and a seven-name roster — the Sabbath's number stamped on the utterance at every scale.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:12 (the lean lengthening; the juxtaposition)
claim_en: kabed et-avikha ve-et-imekha lemaan YAARIKHUN yamekha ('honor your father and your mother, that your days may be LONG'): the may-be-long word written LEAN (no yod — census-unique, checked) — the Kitzur: 'there is NO LENGTH OF DAYS IN THIS WORLD, which was created with He — but in the WORLD TO COME, which was created with YOD' (the reward-word missing exactly the letter of the world where the reward lives: the promise pointing past its own spelling); and the placement-doctrine carried with its English face (the Kitzur, translated in the mirror): 'honoring one's parents is NEXT TO the Sabbath to tell you: just as one is obligated to honor the Sabbath, one is obligated to honor father and mother' (the fifth utterance leaning on the fourth — the two honors one law-family).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:18 (the swaying; the recoil; the doorposts)
claim_en: va-yar ha-am VA-YANUU ('and the people saw, AND THEY SWAYED, and stood far off'): the sway-verb stands ONCE in the Torah (checked) — the Kitzur: 'THEREFORE WE SWAY at the study of Torah — for the Torah was given in awe, in trembling, and in quaking' (the study-house's rocking bodies traced to this verse: the custom's proof-text); the recoil counted (named as the tradition's device): va-yanuu = TWELVE MIL — 'they were driven twelve miles backward' at each utterance (the camp's whole length, the angels walking them back); and the Scripture-twin named: 'AND THE DOORPOSTS SWAYED at the voice' (Isaiah's temple-vision) — 'there by an angel, here by angels' (the two swayings: the prophet's house and the nation's mountain — hinges and humans moved by the same voice).

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 20:18 (the printer convicted twice; the Ramah)
claim_en: ve-khol ha-am roim et-HA-QOLOT ve-et-HA-LAPIDIM ('and all the people were SEEING the VOICES and the TORCHES'): the voices-word written FULL-then-LEAN (first vav full, second lean — census-unique, checked) — 'THIS ALONE is so written' (the Ramah, against the Meiri); and the torches-word likewise FULL-then-LEAN (first yod full, second lean — census-unique, asserted at the build) — with MS convicting the PRINTER a second time: 'the printed edition is GREATLY CONFUSED here, both in the Masorah and in the verses — in all precise manuscripts it is the OPPOSITE; and it seems one must emend: the-people-saw is written FULL-first, and the rest are otherwise' (the printed roster inverted, corrected from the manuscripts and the Ramah's register): the verse in which Israel SEES sound is guarded letter-by-letter twice over — and the seeing itself filed (the readings: they saw what is heard — the senses traded at the mountain, named-only).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:20 (the test-file; the shame-cipher)
claim_en: ki LE-VAAVUR nasot etkhem ba ha-elohim ('for IN ORDER TO TEST you God has come — and in order that His fear be on your faces, that you sin not'): the in-order-to word stands ONCE in the Torah (checked) — the Kitzur's Masorah-three runs to DAVID's court (the woman of Tekoa's 'to turn the face of the matter,' Absalom's 'to bring the evil'): 'if you STAND IN THE TEST you shall be as David... and if not — to bring the evil' (the theophany filed as the corpus's third test-station: God tested with bread, the people tested at the rock, and Sinai itself is nasot); TECHETAU ('that you sin not') — the sin-word's Torah-pair (census checked): REUBEN'S 'do not SIN against the boy' (Gen 42:22) and Moses' 'that you SIN not' (the corpus's two sin-not warnings: a brother's plea and a mediator's charge); and the shame-cipher EXACT (asserted at the build): YIRATO AL PENEKHEM ('His fear on your faces') = ZE HU BOSHET HA-PANIM ('this is SHAME-OF-FACE,' 917 = 917) — the Kitzur: 'whoever has shame of face does not quickly sin; shame restrains where anger invites' (the fear on the face named, by number, as the face's own blush).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 20:21 (the Presence-cipher; Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer)
claim_en: u-moshe NIGASH el-HA-ARAFEL asher-sham ha-elohim ('and Moses DREW NEAR to the THICK CLOUD where God was'): the thick-cloud word stands ONCE in the Torah (checked) — and HA-ARAFEL = SHEKHINA ('the Presence,' 385 = 385, asserted at the build): the darkness named, by number, as exactly What it hides (the Kitzur with the mirror's English face: 'the numerical value of arafel equals that of Shechinah'); the approach-verb read passive (Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer, carried with its translation: 'not he approached but HE WAS BROUGHT NEAR — MICHAEL AND GABRIEL seized him by his two hands and brought him before the Presence against his will'); and the verb's Torah-pair asserted at the build: JOSEPH drawing near to bow before Esau (Gen 33:7) and MOSES drawn near to the dark — the corpus's two nigash-forms: both approaches into fear, one toward a brother's face, one into the cloud where the Face is.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 20:25-26 (the altar-code's letters); Kitzur Baal HaTurim on 20:24/26
claim_en: ki charbekha henafta aleha VA-TECHALLEHA ('for you have lifted your sword upon it, AND PROFANED IT'): the profane-word stands ONCE in the Torah, written with NO YOD (checked; 'so wrote the Ramah'); the altar-code's remaining file: AVO elekha u-verakhtikha — 'I will COME to you and bless you': AVO = TEN (asserted at the build) — the Kitzur: 'if I find TEN in the synagogue, I COME to you and bless you' (the quorum encoded in the coming-verb: the minyan's proof-cipher); TIGALE ('be uncovered') — the Kitzur's Masorah-three named: 'if he uncovers his nakedness on the altar — his evil is uncovered in the assembly' (Proverbs' pair); BE-MAALOT with the bet SOFT — MS against a printed authority ('the Rav Pealim wrote it hard, against the rule — I HAVE SEEN IT SOFT IN ALL THE BOOKS, as its law requires'); and the mil'el stress on elohe-khesef named (one of the Masorah's three): the code that forbids hewn stone and steps kept, itself, unhewn — every letter and stroke in its place.

source: Minchat Shai on the Decalogue's divisions (the Ramah's codices; ibn Ezra's dissenters; the sages)
claim_en: ANOKHI ('I am'): MS's essay on the Decalogue's SECTIONS — the precise codices (the Ramah's book, the Egyptian and Jerusalem exemplars, 'all the land of the Deer and the East,' the Portugal print, the Rambam manuscripts) hold SEVEN CLOSED BREAKS in the Ten, from honor-your-parents onward, SPLITTING THE TWO COVETS ('you shall not covet your fellow's HOUSE' closed off from 'you shall not covet your fellow's WIFE') — the section-count filed as an instrument gap (the SNAPSHOT's stream does not carry the break-marks; named from the codices); and MS names what the split misled some to claim — that the two covets are two utterances and ANOKHI none (ibn Ezra's 'others,' ibn Shuaib's): 'they saw the doubled accents on anokhi and leaned on them — and the truth is AS THE SAGES RECEIVED: ANOKHI and LO-YIHYE are the two utterances HEARD FROM THE MOUTH OF THE POWER' (the corpus's own count stands with the received one: the anokhi-token anchored in-verse, checked — the first utterance is the I).

source: Mishnah Makkot 1:2 + 1:3
claim_en: THE NINTH UTTERANCE'S IMPLEMENTING ROWS — THE PLOTTING WITNESSES. Witnesses proven zomemim ('plotting') on a money debt: the sages — whoever PAYS is not lashed (kol ha-meshalem eino loke), against R. Meir's pay-and-lash (Mishnah Makkot 1:2). Plotted lashes: R. Meir EIGHTY (one forty for lo taane — this utterance — one for Deut 19's as-he-plotted); the sages FORTY (Makkot 1:3). Money is split among plotters; lashes never split. Filed F-024, auto-seated.

source: Mishnah Keritot 6:9
claim_en: FATHER AND MOTHER WEIGHED EQUAL — ON THIS UTTERANCE AND ITS MIRROR. ha-av kodem la-em be-khol makom — yakhol she-kevod ha-av odef ('the father precedes everywhere — could it be his honor OUTWEIGHS?'): talmud lomar ish imo ve-aviv tirau ('each his MOTHER and his father you shall revere,' Leviticus 19:3 reversing our verse's order) — melamed she-shenehem shekulim ('teaching that both are EQUAL'); the sages' precedence where duties collide is administrative (he and his mother both owe the father's honor). Filed F-024, auto-seated.

source: Mishnah Chagigah 3:8; Pirkei Avot 3:6; Tamid 5:1; Shabbat 24:1
claim_en: FOUR STANDING ROWS ON THE UTTERANCES' CHAPTER. (a) THE GROUND-STATUS DISPUTE: the altars alone are not immersed — R. Eliezer because they are LIKE GROUND (the earthen altar of this step's verse the reason), the sages because they are plated (Mishnah Chagigah 3:8). (b) THE ONE-STUDENT WARRANT: u-minayin afilu echad — she-neemar be-khol ha-makom asher azkir et shemi avo elekha u-verakhtikha ('whence even ONE who sits in Torah? — in every place where I cause My Name to be mentioned I will come to you and bless you,' this step's clause; Pirkei Avot 3:6). (c) THE DAILY READING: the Temple read the TEN UTTERANCES every morning with the Shema (Mishnah Tamid 5:1). (d) THE REST ROSTER APPLIED: the purse goes to the GENTILE at nightfall — outside 20:10's rest list — and only failing that onto the donkey, who is IN it (Mishnah Shabbat 24:1). Filed F-024, auto-seated.

source: Bava Kamma 54b:12-14 + Shabbat 153b:7-8 + 120b:11-12 + 117b:8 + Bava Metzia 32a:15-16
claim_en: THE REST ROSTER RUNS. The beast's scope: R. Yosei in R. Yishmael's name compares the tablets ('your cattle' here, 'your ox and your donkey' at Deut 5:14) — everywhere the pair stands, wild beasts and birds stand with it: the whole animal kingdom rests; the generalization-detail shrink refused. The laden animal: driving the loaded donkey collides with this roster (EX20-16's purse row) — resolved by placement on the WALKING animal, no lifting-and-placing. The labor verb's edges: doing barred, causing permitted (with the agitated-owner rider); skill carved from labor (shofar-blowing, bread-removal — the school of R. Yishmael). The parent: honor equated to the Omnipresent's — hence the keeping verse must refuse the parent's desecration-command. Filed F-065, auto-seated (round 17).

source: Pesachim 106a:5-7 + 117b:8 + Berakhot 20b:7-14
claim_en: THE KIDDUSH FILE ON THE REMEMBER-UTTERANCE. Remember it OVER WINE — at the day's entry, with the day's cup from remember-THE-DAY; the EXODUS mentioned in kiddush by the remember-remember link; women obligated by TORAH LAW through the keep-remember pair (whoever is in the keeping is in the remembering) — the pair this step's own prose carried since derivation ('remember-and-keep in one saying'): the third stratum anticipating a third consecutive round; the Grace's women-duty upheld against the time-bound challenge with its Torah-or-rabbinic grade left recorded-open. Filed F-077, auto-seated (round 21, the conduct block).

source: Sotah 38a:9-13 + Berakhot 6a:13 + 54a:9
claim_en: THE NAME-MENTION CLAUSE'S TWO RECORDED JOBS. The blessing-site law: the priestly blessing's explicit Name in the chosen house alone — R. Yoshiya reading the clause INVERTED (wherever I come to you and bless you, THERE I mention My Name), a recorded read-order operation; converts, women, freedmen included, face to face. The study law: the Presence with even one who sits with Torah, the same clause read forward. The greeting-with-the-Name institution beside — all seated next to the crown's own minyan cipher on the coming-verb. Filed F-078, auto-seated (round 21, the conduct block).

source: Rosh Hashanah 24a:18-24b:13 + Avodah Zarah 43b:4-15, 54a:3-5
claim_en: THE IMAGE-MAKING SCOPE MACHINE. The with-Me clause read as the attendants' ban: replicable attendants barred (Temple-form house, table matching the Table, candelabrum matching the Candelabrum — five, six or eight lamps permitted, SEVEN barred in any metal, R. Yosei bar Yehuda even wood against the Hasmonean spits' iron-tin-silver-gold progression); non-replicable — the four faces together, and the human face alone by THE REVOCALIZATION (lo taasun ITI read OTI, 'you shall not make ME' — Rav Huna son of Rav Idi from Abaye's lecture); upper-dwelling attendants barred from making while the SERVING ban runs 20:4's four domains down to the tiny worm; the diagram resolutions (made-by-others with the many, sections, learn-to-understand-and-rule from Deut 18:9) and the seal-ring state pair; the duress gate — live-by-them takes duress out, profane-not puts it back in public (Rava). Filed F-109, auto-seated (round 29, the Decalogue block — the campaign's finale).

THE VAIN-CLAUSE OATH FILE. Rav Dimi citing R. Yochanan assigns the clauses: the PAST falsehood ('I ate / I did not eat') is the vain oath warned from THIS clause, the broken future oath is the false oath warned from Lev 19:12; vain and false were SPOKEN IN ONE UTTERANCE like remember-and-keep — and the sugya's own use of that pair is the women-kiddush derivation EX20-18 has held since round 21, the seat standing inside Shevuot 20b:10's text; the speech-lash exception trio (swearer, exchanger, curser by the Name) flogged with no act; the guiltless clause split between the courts — Heaven does not clear, the court below flogs and clears, fixed by the clause's own subject; and oaths administered on the COURT'S understanding because elo'ah also names idols — 'gods of silver and gods of gold' (20:23). Filed F-110, auto-seated (round 29, the Decalogue block).

source: Berakhot 7a:26-27 + Sanhedrin 99a:21 + Bava Metzia 5b:18-20 + Beitzah 15b:4-5 + Bava Kamma 74b:7-9 + Sanhedrin 86a:15-17 (standing, the persons block)
claim_en: THE UTTERANCES' RIDER FILE. The visited iniquity harmonized — visited only when they grasp their fathers' deeds in their hands, against Deut 24:16; the first utterance's denier — the idolater classified as one who despises THE UTTERANCE said to Moses at Sinai (the school of R. Yishmael); the covet ban's recorded folk-parameter — to people it means taking WITHOUT payment; the remember-verb's institution — eruv tavshilin from 'remember it in the face of another day that comes to make it forgotten' (Shmuel, with Rava's alternative); the ninth utterance's own lash — contradicted capital witnesses flogged (R. Elazar, against the executed arm) with the death-warning-prohibition exemption principle; and the eighth utterance's scope — theft of PERSONS by the named context middah, Lev 19:11's theft property by its own. Filed F-111, auto-seated (round 29, the Decalogue block).

THE ALTAR PARAGRAPH'S BABYLONIAN LAYER. Levi's build baraita — poured frames (32 by 32, then 30 by 30, then 28 by 28) with lime, quicklime and pitch melted and poured: whole stones bound without iron, the construction protocol of EX20-12's sword-profanes clause; the upon-it clause expounded by both arms — R. Yosei (all the top for either offering) against R. Yosei son of R. Yehuda (half burnt, half peace); the wholeness gate — 'upon it' when whole and not when lacking, the verse Rav lost and R. Shimon son of Rabbi restored, with the living-animals-rejected dispute; and the three-stones material census assigning Shiloh, Nov-and-Gibeon, and the Eternal House. Filed F-112, auto-seated (round 29, the Decalogue block).
